observed: As test user 1 (User profile, no Manage Shared Views): POST /api/v1/modules/{Leads}/views {kind:list, name:QA CV api-public, visibility:everyone} -> 201; the same with a complete body -> 201. observed: Owner created QA CV shared (visibility selected, shared with test user 1 only).
